title: Makes a Nice Gift
text: Makes a Nice Gift. This Vera Bradley set would make a nice gift. The items come in a cute satin drawstring bag. The set includes a pillow case, eye mask, and hair scrunchy. My favorite item is the pillow case. I'm using it in my bed. I like that it has an envelope style closure so my pillow isn't slowly sneaking out of the case! It's very soft and silky. The scrunchy isn't big enough for my thick hair. The eye mask is pretty thin, but it's decent. I have to use ones that are molded so they're not laying directly on my eyes. I was using flat ones every night for a while and I noticed my eyelashes were starting to grow sideways a bit. I stopped that right away! The items have a lovely pattern. The quality is pretty good, too.
